messages:
james_sales: kicking off a quick sync — customer (AcmeFin) wants a 4-week pilot. need to lock POC scope + success criteria so we can size Dedicated vs hosted and price it. who can join later today?
anya_se: i can join. key things to align: top 3 customer use cases, sample prompt sets, latency/cost targets, and what counts as 'pass' for quality.
taylor_eng: i'll help with perf SLOs and test harness. do they have throughput/peak tokens/sec numbers?
mike_customer: we expect ~120 qps peak for the chat path during business hours, avg 30 qps otherwise. typical messages 150 tokens in, 60 generated.
priya_account: helpful. James—customer asked about discounts on pilot + enterprise T&Cs. we should propose a time-limited pilot rate and a commitment-based uplink for Dedicated.
james_sales: yes — propose pilot pricing: hosted rate with 50% pilot discount up to a $5k cap then conversion to committed if they like. open to engineering input.
anya_se: for scope: 1) customer support triage + suggested replies, 2) internal knowledge search + summarization, 3) payment reconciliation assistant. each needs separate eval sets.
sarah_security: i'll need the security questionnaire answers by EOD tomorrow. key asks: data residency (EU vs US), KMS integration, audit logs, retention, and whether PII leaves their VPC.
mike_customer: they need EU residency and we must not store logs longer than 30 days. KMS is ok, we use Azure Key Vault.
sarah_security: we support KMS/HSM integrations for Private; hosted can accept customer-managed keys for the pilot (requires contract addendum). audit logs: we can provide request-level telemetry for the POC.
taylor_eng: proposed acceptance KPIs draft: 
```
- Latency: p50 <= 220ms, p95 <= 650ms for chat generate path (150 input tokens)
- Cost: avg per-generated-token cost <= $0.0009 (pilot-weighted)
- Quality: automated eval + human spot-checks: >= 92% pass on rubric (relevance & safety)
- Reliability: 99.5% success rate (no error) during scripted load testing
```
this is baseline — can slack up p95 if they accept higher cost.
priya_account: client asks that acceptance be based on production-like traffic for 24h, not just synthetic runs. can we do a shadow run?
taylor_eng: yes, recommend a 24h shadow with traffic replay. will need an integration hook and a routing policy (weight=0.2) to avoid customer-facing regressions.
james_sales: timeline proposal: 
- Week0: kick-off, security Qs done, creds & sample data
- Week1: prompt collection + baseline run against hosted model, eval scripts
- Week2: integration and shadow traffic, iterate prompts
- Week3: load testing (scale to 120 qps), latency/cost tuning
- Week4: acceptance window + handoff to ops if pass
any objections?
anya_se: looks good. deliverables from our side: prompt templates, eval harness, A/B model variants for fallbacks.
sarah_security: deliverables from security: completed questionnaire, privacy addendum draft, KMS onboarding doc.
mike_customer: timeline aligns with our procurement window. two asks: 1) can we get a short SOC2 exposure summary for sales? 2) fallback policy if Dedicated isn't ready?
priya_account: we'll attach SOC2 summary (sales doc). fallback: auto-route to hosted model variant with slightly higher latency/cost, allowed per policy. need to confirm SLA for pilot.
james_sales: pricing Q: if they convert to Dedicated after pilot, propose a 12mo commit with monthly true-up; discount ladder tied to committed tokens. engineering — any blocker on migration windows?
taylor_eng: migration is straightforward if model version pinned. main work is data residency switch and KMS keys rebind. plan ~2 days ops work during migration.
sarah_security: note — for EU residency we need private deployment or EU-hosted Dedicated. confirm region early.
sec-bot: Security checklist created: https://redwood.internal/pocs/1776001234/checklist (auto)
anya_se: for eval metrics — we'll run both automated (BLEU/ROUGE where applicable) and human pairwise preference for the top 200 responses. acceptance threshold: >= 60% win-rate vs their baseline.
mike_customer: 60% sounds fair. can we scope the human review panel? we'll provide two SME reviewers.
james_sales: great. final action items: 1) Sarah — questionnaire answers + privacy addendum by tomorrow EOD. 2) Anya/Taylor — eval harness + sample prompts by Wednesday. 3) Priya — draft pilot commercial terms + pilot discount offer. 4) Mike — sample dataset + traffic replay by Wed. i'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 11am.
anya_se: noted, will prep prompt template and a short runbook for shadowing.
taylor_eng: i'll prepare load test plan and a small script: 
```bash
# quick replay example
python replay.py --input sample_replay.json --qps 120 --duration 3600 --target redwood-hosted-endpoint
```
priya_account: i'll draft the contract language for pilot KMS and data residency exceptions.
mike_customer: thanks all — see you at 11am tomorrow. excited to get this moving. :rocket:
